summary: File attribute check-and-fix sequence for a given file name. Starts with result = 1 (success). If the attribute check with flag 0 does not return -1, and the check with flag 6 reports the attribute present, the file's read-only attribute is toggled via the Win32 API with value 128, and a recheck with flag 6 decides the outcome: if the attribute is still present the function returns 0 (failure), otherwise the initial success value is returned.

operations.description: Initialize result to 1 before any check runs.
Guard on FileAttributeCheckWithErrorHandling(lpFileName, 0) != -1; when it equals -1 the rest of the sequence is skipped and result remains 1.
Call FileAttributeCheckWithErrorHandling(lpFileName, 6); a non-zero (true) result proceeds to the toggle step.
Call ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API(lpFileName, 128) to flip the read-only attribute state.
Recheck FileAttributeCheckWithErrorHandling(lpFileName, 6); if it is still true the function returns 0 immediately.
Return the preserved result (1 on the normal path, 0 on the failed-toggle path).

unresolved: The exact meaning of the attribute-check flag values 0 and 6 and of the value 128 passed to the toggle helper is not established from this packet.
The callers sub_566940 and sub_566A70 determine when this attribute repair sequence is invoked.
